issues.description: Method getNumberOfStudentsPerTutor(): return type differs between artifacts. The UML in problem_statement.md declares getNumberOfStudentsPerTutor(): int (problem_statement.md line 72), while the template guidance comment explicitly recommends a double return type (template Lecture.java comment at line 17) and the solution implementation defines the method as public double getNumberOfStudentsPerTutor() (solution Lecture.java line 85). This discrepancy will confuse students about which return type to implement and may cause mismatches with automated checks or examples.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the return type consistent across artifacts. Preferred fix: update the UML in problem_statement.md to declare getNumberOfStudentsPerTutor(): double so it matches the template comment and the solution implementation (this preserves fractional/precise students-per-tutor calculation). Alternatively, if only integer values are intended, change the template comment and the solution implementation to return int and update any examples/tests accordingly. Ensure the UML, template comments, and solution all use the same signature.
